changes.summary: Extended the existing generated block-owner control across ASCII and Binary DXF: twelve ordered ATTRIB records and SEQEND follow an INSERT in an earlier named block; a later block contains an attribute-free INSERT; empty anonymous, populated anonymous, and paper-layout block definitions follow. Assertions cover the seven-row BLOCK_RECORD/BLOCK/ENDBLK identity bijection, child owners and per-body type counts, group 66 and sequence termination, sibling order, fixed model/paper sentinels, terminal section and EOF.
Records the completed generated fast slice, its scope/evidence ceiling, focused validation, and current uncommitted status in the implementation-progress ledger.

evidence_limits: ASCII/Binary DXF output was generated locally at runtime; no drawing fixture was added or committed.

The assertions qualify local DXF writer/adapter structure only. They do not reproduce LibreDWG's implementation-specific cursor failure, qualify DWG reader source completeness, establish native CAD acceptance, or promote semantic support claims.
No full test suite, external peer executable, native CAD application, dependency, or new CTest registration was used.
